promptZh: 阅读短文，在空白处填入 1 个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文讲述高中生李华暑假在医院做志愿者的经历，这段经历坚定了他学医的梦想。
explanation.ruleZh: 语法填空要先看句子结构与时间状语：过去时间用过去式，比较结构用比较级，介词后用代词宾格，冠词看读音，括号内提示词按句法要求变形。

evidence.quote: Last summer, he ____ (spend) three weeks volunteering at a hospital near his home
One elderly woman said that Li Hua's smile made her feel much

segments.text: Li Hua is a senior high school student who
(dream) of becoming a doctor. Last summer, he

(spend) three weeks volunteering at a hospital near his home. Every morning he arrived at seven and helped the nurses carry medicine to the wards. At first he felt nervous because he had never worked in
hospital before, but soon the staff treated him like a real member of the team. He learned to calm patients down by talking with
(they) about their families and hobbies. One elderly woman said that Li Hua's smile made her feel much
(warm) than any medicine did. On the last day, the head nurse praised him for being patient and hard-working. Li Hua says this experience taught him
important lesson: even small acts of kindness can change
(someone) day. He has now made up his mind
(study) medicine at university. He believes his dream will come true
he keeps working hard, and his parents are proud of
(he) for choosing such a meaningful goal.

gaps.label: 第1空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: who 指代 a senior high school student，从句描述现在的身份与理想，主语为第三人称单数，故填 dreams。

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: Last summer 是明确的过去时间，谓语动词用过去式 spent。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.explanationZh: hospital 是可数名词单数，此处泛指“一家医院”，且以辅音音素开头，填 a。

gaps.label: 第4空
gaps.clue: 用括号内代词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 介词 with 后接人称代词宾格，填 them。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.clue: 用括号内形容词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 由 much 和后面的 than 可知用比较级，填 warmer。

gaps.label: 第6空
gaps.explanationZh: important 以元音音素开头，表示“一堂重要的课”用 an。

gaps.label: 第7空
gaps.clue: 用括号内词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 空后是名词 day，需要所有格形式 someone's，表示“某个人的（一天）”。

gaps.label: 第8空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: make up one's mind to do sth 表示“下决心做某事”，填 to study。

gaps.label: 第9空
gaps.explanationZh: 句意为“如果他一直努力，梦想就会实现”，条件状语从句填 if。

gaps.label: 第10空
gaps.clue: 用括号内代词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 介词 of 后接人称代词宾格，填 him。
